SELECT h.ACCOUNTID , h.USERID , h.TRANID , h.TRANTYPE , h.TRANAMOUNT , h.TRANAFTAMOUNT , h.DESCRIPTION , h.CATEGORYID , (SELECT CATEGORYNM FROM ACC_CATEGORY WHERE USERID = #{USERID} AND CATEGORYID = h.CATEGORYID) AS CATEGORYNM , DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRANDATE , h.DELYN , a.ACCOUNTNUM FROM ACC_HISTORY h INNER JOIN ACC_ACCOUNT a ON h.ACCOUNTID= a.ACCOUNTID AND h.USERID= a.USERID WHERE h.USERID = #{USERID}
AND DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
AND a.BANKNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.TRANTYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.CATEGORYID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.TRANAMOUNT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY h.TRANDATE ASC, h.TRANID ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ACC_HISTORY h INNER JOIN ACC_ACCOUNT a ON h.ACCOUNTID = a.ACCOUNTID AND h.USERID = a.USERID WHERE h.USERID = #{USERID}
AND DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
AND a.BANKNM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.TRANTYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.CATEGORYID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND h.TRANAMOUNT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')

SELECT DISTINCT h.CATEGORYID , c.CATEGORYNM FROM ACC_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN ACC_CATEGORY c ON h.USERID = c.USERID AND h.CATEGORYID = c.CATEGORYID WHERE h.USERID = #{USERID} AND h.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.CATEGORYID

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANTYPE = 'I' THEN TRANAMOUNT END), 0) AS INCOME, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANTYPE = 'O' THEN TRANAMOUNT END), 0) AS EXPENSE FROM ACC_HISTORY WHERE USERID = #{USERID} AND DATE_FORMAT(TRANDATE, '%Y-%m') = #{month} AND DELYN = 'N'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.TRANAFTAMOUNT, a.INITMONEY)), 0) FROM ACC_ACCOUNT a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT h1.ACCOUNTID, h1.TRANAFTAMOUNT FROM ACC_HISTORY h1 WHERE h1.USERID = #{USERID} AND h1.DELYN = 'N' AND h1.TRANID = ( SELECT h2.TRANID FROM ACC_HISTORY h2 WHERE h2.ACCOUNTID = h1.ACCOUNTID AND h2.USERID = #{USERID} AND h2.DELYN = 'N' AND h2.TRANDATE <= LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m')) ORDER BY h2.TRANDATE DESC, h2.TRANID DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) t ON a.ACCOUNTID = t.ACCOUNTID WHERE a.USERID = #{USERID}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%m') AS MONTH , c.CATEGORYNM , c.CLASSIFICATION , SUM(h.TRANAMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM ACC_HISTORY h INNER JOIN ACC_CATEGORY c ON h.CATEGORYID = c.CATEGORYID WHERE h.DELYN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%Y') = #{YEAR} AND h.USERID = #{USERID} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.TRANDATE, '%m'), c.CATEGORYNM, c.CLASSIFICATION ORDER BY MONTH, c.CLASSIFICATION DESC, c.CATEGORYNM

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h1.TRANDATE, '%m') AS MONTH , h1.TRANAFTAMOUNT AS BALANCE FROM ACC_HISTORY h1 WHERE h1.DELYN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(h1.TRANDATE, '%Y') = #{YEAR} AND h1.USERID = #{userId} AND h1.TRANDATE = ( SELECT MAX(h2.TRANDATE) FROM ACC_HISTORY h2 WHERE h2.DELYN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(h2.TRANDATE, '%Y') = #{YEAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(h2.TRANDATE, '%m') = DATE_FORMAT(h1.TRANDATE, '%m') AND h2.USERID = #{USERID} ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h1.TRANDATE, '%m'), h1.TRANAFTAMOUNT ORDER BY MONTH
